work.title: Check commit and pull-request provenance in CI: attribution shapes, tool-named branches and the owner's commit identity
work.ownerAuthorization: Owner approval of 2026-11-03 (12:44 UTC) in the Project Hub thread of set A of the Git history attribution cleanup plan: port the attribution check to Readela without ruleset changes. It covers this pull request and its merge under the standing merge approval (DEC-160). It does not authorize a history rewrite, tag move, branch deletion, ruleset or required-check change, release or store change.

parentPreflight.reason: No open work unit covers CI provenance checks; this is a new bounded unit with its own light assertion.

inScope: scripts/check-attribution.mjs (shared with the website repository), test/repo/attribution-check.test.mjs with synthetic fixtures, and the npm test glob that runs it.
.github/workflows/attribution.yml, a check-only workflow on pushes to main and on pull requests, including edits.
docs/project-instructions.md: one Working rules bullet on commit identity and the check.
outOfScope: Rewriting history, moving tags, deleting branches and changing the main ruleset or its required checks; each needs the owner's separate approval.
Application code, permissions, the version, tags, releases and store listings.

fullPreflightTrigger.assessment: A read-only CI check is added. No Capability, baseline identity, architecture or trust boundary changes, and no product code changes. Reversal is a revert.
